trust_decision.summary: The CStudio chunked-upload script trusts an anonymous caller. It also trusts the caller-supplied temp key (a path component under the local cache dir, appended to with raw request body or unlinked) and the final file name (POST on finish, $_FILES name on post-unsupported). No session check runs and no dangerous-name filter is applied anywhere in public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/inc/big-upload.php.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the CStudio upload flow, and this is the only upload dispatcher under import-project. Its switch exposes upload, abort, finish and post-unsupported in one file.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP: plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/inc/big-upload.php (all actions); fix.diff:22-27 adds an api_get_user_id() gate before dispatch
HTTP: big-upload.php?action=upload|abort|finish with GET/POST key; fix.diff:37-40 sanitizes key (local temp path in uploadFile:152 / abortUpload:171 / finishUpload:211)
HTTP: big-upload.php?action=finish; fix.diff:44-54,67-71 binds the final name to the session at first chunk instead of POST name
Browser client of big-upload.php?action=upload; fix.diff:83-85 sends &name= on the first chunk

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All server-side changes are in public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/inc/big-upload.php. The only other change is the client JS at public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/js/big_upload.js:193. A search for php://input writers and a BigUpload class found no second chunked-upload implementation in the tree.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The image-blob and image-fetch endpoints in public/plugin/CStudio/ajax/ write only into private Flysystem storage (var/upload/plugins, config/packages/oneup_flysystem.yaml:116-118, served through the extension-allow-listed public/plugin/CStudio/img-cache.php:33-76). A solver can argue they are a different editor feature and not the 'import upload flow', so not an RCE route.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The legitimate chunked import must keep working. Keys the server generates (mt_rand().'.tmp') must survive key sanitization. finish must still produce the user's real file name, because the client reads response.finalName and navigates to import.php?action=present&namesrc=<finalName>, which reads that file from the import folder and unzips it. Rejecting or blanking names, or refusing keys with dots, breaks project import.

O6_input_shapes: temp key via POST (key=), POST overriding GET (big-upload.php:265-270)
final name via POST name on action=finish (big-upload.php:285)
final name via multipart $_FILES['bigUploadFile']['name'] on action=post-unsupported (big-upload.php:243)
final name via GET name on first chunk (new channel, fix.diff:50-54)

O7_producer.where: At the pinned commit, finish takes its name straight from POST (public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/inc/big-upload.php:285). The fix adds a session-held name that the upload request produces and finish consumes (fix.diff:44-54,69). That state crosses requests but does not exist pre-fix.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ajax.upldblob.php has no authentication check. On ?step it moves a temp blob to img_cache/<folder>/<name>, with name from get_string_from (no slash stripping, no disable_dangerous_file). Without step it writes the uploaded $_FILES['file'] content to plugin storage.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Image-blob helper for the editor, not the import flow. The upload branch forces a .png name (ajax.upldblob.php:58-66) and writes to private Flysystem storage, not webroot.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory (public/plugin/CStudio/ajax/ vs editor/import-project/inc/), same plugin package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ajax.upldimg.php accepts anonymous callers: oel_ctr_rights returns true when the session has no idsessionedition. It then writes attacker-chosen content (fopen of a caller path/URL) under a caller-chosen name that keeps any extension (get_clean_idstring only lowercases/replaces a few chars).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Presented as a 'cache a remote image' fetcher guarded by oel_ctr_rights (public/plugin/CStudio/ajax/inc/functions.php:100-119), not an upload. Output stays in private plugin storage.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory and helper file (ajax/ + ajax/inc/functions.php), same plugin package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extra switch case (e.g. 'resume' or 'status') that rebuilds the temp path from raw $_REQUEST['key'] or $_GET['key'] instead of the parsed $tempName, so the key sanitization never applies (identity differential on the key).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The script already reads key from both GET and POST with POST precedence (big-upload.php:265-270), and a resume/status action is a standard addition to chunked uploaders.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: finishUpload re-derives the extension from the temp file or the original client name after the session name was sanitized (rename-after-check).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Import flows often keep the client's original extension so the later unzip and type checks in import.php/import-file.php work.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A shared filename helper (filter_filename/get_clean_idstring) that big-upload.php could call instead of disable_dangerous_file. It keeps '.php' and dots, so a fix routed through it looks sanitized but is not.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The plugin already uses these helpers for file names in import-file.php:189 and ajax.upldimg.php:62-64.

O9_family: unrestricted file upload with path traversal in a temp-file key, plus missing authentication (CWE-434/CWE-22/CWE-94/CWE-219)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + Composer (Symfony kernel; vendor/ not present in the screen tree)
services: web server (Apache/nginx + php-fpm) for plugin scripts under public/
O10_build.project_tests: None found for CStudio or the BigUpload flow (no tests/**/*CStudio*, *BigUpload*, *big_upload*). The plugin scripts are procedural top-level PHP files, so behavioural tests must run over HTTP against an installed instance.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an auth check and wrap only POST name in finish with disable_dangerous_file. That leaves the raw key path component (append in uploadFile:152, unlink in abortUpload:171) and the post-unsupported $_FILES name at :243 untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/import-copy.php:39-46 runs copy actions with caller-supplied src/dst before any auth or CSRF check; an extension allow-list (:83-87) limits it.
public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/import.php:182-191 extracts zip entry names into plugin storage without filtering entry names (zip-slip within Flysystem root).

public/plugin/CStudio/editor/import-project/import-file.php:176 relies on isFileDirectUpload, which matches the extension as a substring anywhere in the name (public/plugin/CStudio/ajax/inc/functions.php:285-299).
public/plugin/CStudio/ajax/ajax.upldimg.php:75-86 fopen of a caller-supplied path or URL (possible SSRF/local read) is a different weakness.
unverified: That api_replace_dangerous_char (URLify::filter, public/main/inc/lib/api.lib.php:5332-5344) strips '/' and '..' from the key: vendor/ is absent, so URLify was not read.

That disable_dangerous_file is loaded for plugin scripts: it is defined in public/main/inc/lib/fileUpload.lib.php:48 and required by public/legacy.php:15. The include chain from global.inc.php to legacy.php was not traced.
The exact RCE path, inferred as key traversal from Container::getCacheDir()/cstudio_upload/ into a web-served PHP file via uploadFile's append. The advisory text was not available, only the diff.
